items.title: Roman Empire
items.creator: WildPhire
items.description:
Explore the mighty Roman Empire! 
Take on up to 80 missions, uncover ancient cities, and relive epic moments. 
Perfect for roleplaying as a citizen, ruler, or trader.

- 80 Missions 
- Roman Roleplay Map 
- Explore Ancient Lands

items.title: The Kingdom of Avelori
items.creator: Team VoidFeather
items.description: The Kingdom of Avelori looms over Eldrithor's shadowed lands. Beneath its proud castle lie hidden chambers, guarding untold secrets and forgotten legends—a realm where history and mystery intertwine!

items.title: Anime School
items.creator: QwertyuiopThePie
items.description:
You love anime? Step into the world of stylish school life with this cool skin pack and express your personality! 

+ 12 anime school skins
+ Great for roleplay
+ fun accessories & hair styles

items.title: Neon Shadows
items.creator: Dexity
items.description:
Step into the mysterious world of Neon Shadows! This pack features 10 striking skins with glowing neon accents and dark, edgy styles. Perfect for those who want to stand out with a futuristic, bold, and shadowy vibe.

+ Perfect for roleplay!
+ Have fun!
By Dexity

items.title: 5 Star Hotel: Roleplay
items.creator: Wonder
items.description:
Take charge of your own hotel! Become an owner or guest of this super detailed 5 star hotel!

- 400+ of decoration models
- Complete quests
- Redesign rooms
- Live in luxury hotel

items.title: Emo Teens
items.creator: Entity Builds
items.description: Moody, brooding, and dressed in all black, these teens wear their angst on their sleeves. From skull shirts to monotone hoodies, each look brings a serious attitude with an edge. Perfect for those who’d rather lurk in the shadows than stand in the spotlight.

items.title: Mob Thieves!
items.creator: Entity Builds
items.description: Sneaky, swift, and always on the move—the Mob Thieves are here! These crafty creatures have mastered the art of stealing blocks and vanishing into the night. From mischievous endermen to silent creepers, each one has grabbed their loot and is ready for adventure. Pick your favorite, embrace the chaos, and join the ultimate heist!

items.title: sci-fi
items.creator: Mine-North
items.description:
Suiting up for a deep-space mission or sneaking through a neon-lit city—these skins got you covered. 
The sci-fi Skin Pack brings futuristic warriors, rogue androids, and tech-enhanced explorers straight into your world.
- 1 free skin
- 12 skins in total
Ready to upgrade your style?

items.title: Raft Survival 2
items.creator: G2Crafted
items.description: Survive the sea in Raft Survival 2! Use the Net Blaster to collect ocean loot and floating chests, build with 2 new wood types (Cotton & Banana), battle sharks, orcas, jellyfish, and Illag-mers! Discover underwater dungeons, use the Totem of Retention to keep items on death, and sift resources with the Sieve. A wave of survival fun awaits!

items.title: Epic Legends
items.creator: Asiago Bagels
items.description:
Keep it cool and trendy as one of these 12 EPIC legends! Take over the world and impress everyone as an amazing stylish star!

+ 12 Skins!
+ Perfect for Roleplaying!

items.title: Shadows and Spirits
items.creator: CHRONICOVERRIDE LLC
items.description:
Transform your Minecraft world into a spine-chilling nightmare with this horror survival Add-On!
- 10 custom monsters lurking in the shadows
- 10 powerful new items to discover
- 3 custom armor sets with bespoke abilities
- 3 custom weapons with unbelievable abilities
- Custom throwables and more!
Survive, fight, and thrive in the darkness!
items.changelog:
Changes in the new update:
- Improved mob behaviors
- Added custom death sounds
- Added new weapon animations and sounds
- Spectral Spear can now be used as a melee weapon or thrown
- Added custom projectile for Bonemonger
- Increased overall volume for custom sounds
- Updated thumbnail

items.title: Warden Knights
items.creator: Aurrora
items.description: Whats better than a medieval knight skin pack? Dark, mighty, Warden knight skins! Get your sword ready and take over the kingdom with these dark skins.

items.title: Knights

items.description:
These knights are ready for battle! Pick any of these epic knights for your next roleplay or survival adventure!

+ Includes 10+ knights

Shine bright like your favorite idols with the Korean Stars skin pack! Inspired by the hottest K-pop groups, Korean dramas, and trendsetting Seoul street fashion, this skin pack features a dazzling lineup of stylish characters.

Unleash your inner feline hero! Rock stylish cat ears, epic outfits, and ultimate kawaii vibes. Perfect for gamers who love cool, cat-tastic looks. Be the leader of your squad!

+ Neko-themed Skins
+ 12 skins
+ By Atheris Games

Join the 'Rich Buddies' skin pack and roll in style with awesome outfits! Rock the coolest looks, from slick suits to fancy dresses, and show off your swag in Blockworld. Get ready to flex your fashion game, because it's time to be the trendiest teen in town!

+ 12 skins

Dive into the "Creepers vs Teens" pack - a rad pixelated brawl! Pick sides, gear up, and let the epic battle commence! Show your skills!

+ 12 skins

items.title: Prime PvP
items.creator: Big Dye Gaming
items.description:
Jump into battle with PvP Prime! Choose your style, sharpen your skills, and fight to win. Outsmart opponents, claim victory, and rule the arena!

-10 PvP-themed skins.
-Perfect for battle arenas. 

By Big Dye Gaming

items.title: ZOMBIFIED 1.2 Add-On
items.creator: Levelatics
items.description:
ZOMBIFY your world with the ZOMBIFIED Add-On!
Brace yourself for HORDE NIGHTS, INFECTED BIOMES, CUSTOM STRUCTURES, and over a ton of ZOMBIES!

items.changelog:

- Effects no longer get randomly removed

items.title: Nightmares
items.creator: Pixel Squared
items.description:
Night has fallen across the land, and now the monsters have come out to play! Scare your friends with these nightmarish skins and be the spookiest on the server.

+ 13 HD skins!
+ Horrible, horrific, scary designs!
+ I'm going to have nightmares after this!

By Pixel Squared

items.title: ORES

items.description:
Unearth your inner gem with these ore teen skins!. Combine vibrant hues like redstone and lapis lazuli with awesome teen skins, and rep your favorite ore!

items.title: Meteors Add-On
items.creator: Sapphire Studios
items.description:
Transform your world with the Meteors Add-On! Survive meteor showers and battle cosmic aliens & golems to forge powerful gravity armor and tools. 

+ Dynamic World Events
+ New Hostile Mobs
+ Tameable Pets
+ New Ore
+ Craftable Weapons and Tools 
+ New Structures and Loot

The sky is no longer the limit—it's a new adventure

Gear up with the latest trends! Show off your fashion game and lead the way in every adventure. Get ready to rule the scene with confidence!

items.title: Ancient Grove

Dive into Ancient Grove, a survival world filled with ancient forests, forgotten ruins, and ancestral magic! Face the challenges of a wild and mysterious biome, where nature hides ancestral secrets, hidden paths, and legendary treasures.
